title: Each hand-written technical record of Declaring fills exactly one slot
when: Runs the pinned Lathe check with structured output on STEGO's spec at the commit under test, and reads each technical record of ST-DECL that no tooling record generates and nothing provides.
then: Expects each such record to fill exactly one slot of ST-PAT-GO-CODE, and names each record that fills none or more than one.
notes: Not automated yet. Integration level, because it runs Lathe on the data files. It reads the same check output as the coverage reader of Assuring, so it adds no second reading of the spec.

title: Distributing's hand-written technical records each fill exactly one slot
when: Reads the spec at the commit under test with lathe check --json, and lists each technical record of ST-DIS that no tooling record generates and nothing provides, with the fills that start from it.
then: Expects each such record to fill exactly one slot of ST-PAT-GO-CODE, and no record of ST-DIS to fill two slots or none.
notes: The test number is the domain's position in the product (ST-ASR 1 to ST-SUP 8; ST-DIS is 4 and ST-GEN is 7), so that the test plans of other domains, written on parallel branches, take other numbers.

title: Each hand-written technical record of Delivering fills exactly one slot
when: Reads the spec at the commit under test with the pinned Lathe and lists each technical record of ST-DLV that no tooling record generates and nothing provides, with the slots it fills.
then: Expects each such record to fill exactly one slot of ST-PAT-GO-CODE, and the spec check to report no pattern-not-followed finding for ST-DLV.
notes: The ID T05 is the position of Delivering among the domains, so that the test plans of other domains, written at the same time, take other IDs.

title: Each hand-written technical record of Extending fills exactly one slot of the Go code pattern
when: Load STEGO's spec at the commit under test with the Lathe version that STEGO pins, and read the slot fillings (data/fills.jsonl) of each technical record of ST-EXT that no tooling record generates and nothing provides.
then: Expects each such record of ST-EXT to fill exactly one slot of ST-PAT-GO-CODE, and names each record that fills none or more than one.
notes: Not automated yet: no test reads the slot fillings. A record with no filling and a record with two fillings are the two faults; the test lists both kinds, not only the first one it finds. lathe check --json does not print the fillings, so the test reads them from the data.

title: Generating's hand-written technical records each fill exactly one slot
when: Reads the spec at the commit under test with lathe check --json, and lists each technical record of ST-GEN that no tooling record generates and nothing provides, with the fills that start from it.
then: Expects each such record to fill exactly one slot of ST-PAT-GO-CODE, and no record of ST-GEN to fill two slots or none.
notes: The test number is the domain's position in the product (ST-ASR 1 to ST-SUP 8; ST-DIS is 4 and ST-GEN is 7), so that the test plans of other domains, written on parallel branches, take other numbers.

title: Each hand-written technical record of Supplying fills exactly one slot of the Go code pattern
when: Runs lathe check on STEGO's specification at the commit under test, and reads the fills of each technical record of Supplying that no tooling record generates and nothing provides.
then: Expects each such record to fill exactly one slot of ST-PAT-GO-CODE, and no record of Supplying to be reported as accidental-not-accounted-for.

title: Each fill of Declaring serves an essential record
when: Runs the pinned Lathe check with structured output on STEGO's spec at the commit under test, and reads the accidental-not-accounted-for findings of ST-DECL.
then: Expects no fill of ST-DECL that implements, builds or sits under no essential record.
notes: Not automated yet. On main the check names ST-DECL-CH01 and ST-DECL-REPO01, so the test fails until they are put under an essential record or removed. A finding is not hidden by a list of known faults.

title: Distributing's fills each serve an essential record
when: Reads the spec at the commit under test with lathe check --json, and lists each fill of ST-DIS with the record it implements, builds or sits under.
then: Expects each fill of ST-DIS to implement, build or sit under an essential record, and no fill to serve only technical records.
notes: The test number is the domain's position in the product (ST-ASR 1 to ST-SUP 8; ST-DIS is 4 and ST-GEN is 7), so that the test plans of other domains, written on parallel branches, take other numbers.

title: Each fill of Delivering serves an essential record
when: Reads the spec at the commit under test with the pinned Lathe and lists each fill of ST-DLV.
then: Expects each fill to implement, build or sit under an essential record, and the spec check to report no accidental-not-accounted-for finding for ST-DLV.
notes: Today the check reports ST-DLV-CH01, ST-DLV-CH02, ST-DLV-REPO01, ST-DLV-REPO02, ST-DLV-REPO03 and ST-DLV-REPO05, so the test fails until they are put under the records they serve. The ID T05 is the position of Delivering among the domains, so that the test plans of other domains, written at the same time, take other IDs.

title: Each fill of the Go code pattern in Extending serves an essential record, and no Go file of Extending serves none
when: Load STEGO's spec at the commit under test with the Lathe version that STEGO pins. For each record of ST-EXT that fills a slot of ST-PAT-GO-CODE, follow its implements link or its parent. Then list the Go files of the packages that the technical records of ST-EXT name.
then: Expects each such record to implement, build or sit under an essential record of STEGO, and each Go file in those packages to be named by such a record.
notes: Not automated yet: no test follows the fillings to essential records. The scan of Go files catches code that a record does not name, which the rule says to remove.

title: Generating's fills each serve an essential record
when: Reads the spec at the commit under test with lathe check --json, and lists each fill of ST-GEN with the record it implements, builds or sits under.
then: Expects each fill of ST-GEN to implement, build or sit under an essential record, and no fill to serve only technical records.
notes: The test number is the domain's position in the product (ST-ASR 1 to ST-SUP 8; ST-DIS is 4 and ST-GEN is 7), so that the test plans of other domains, written on parallel branches, take other numbers.

title: Each fill of Supplying implements, builds or sits under an essential record
when: Runs lathe check on STEGO's specification at the commit under test, and reads each fill of Supplying with the record it implements, builds or sits under.
then: Expects each fill to reach an essential record, and no source file of Supplying to be reported as code-file-untraced.

title: Each fill of Declaring meets the rules of ST-STD-CODE that apply to its kind
when: Runs the code standard checks of internal/assure over the files that the technical records of ST-DECL name, at the commit under test.
then: Expects no fault of any rule of ST-STD-CODE in those files outside the committed list of known faults (ST-ASR-TOOL03), and no listed fault that the files no longer have.
notes: Not automated yet. It matches the standard rule tests ST-STD-CODE-R01-T01 to R03-T01 in form, scoped to the files of one domain. On main internal/types and internal/parser hold files of more than one domain (ST-STD-CODE-R01).

title: Distributing's fills meet every rule of the code standard that applies to them
when: Runs the checks of ST-STD-CODE (the code standard test in internal/assure) over the files that the fills of ST-DIS name.
then: Expects no fault in those files outside the committed list of known faults (ST-ASR-TOOL03) at the same commit, no listed fault of those files that the tree no longer has, and no fault of those files in the list that the list at the base commit does not hold, as the tests of ST-STD-CODE expect.
notes: The test number is the domain's position in the product (ST-ASR 1 to ST-SUP 8; ST-DIS is 4 and ST-GEN is 7), so that the test plans of other domains, written on parallel branches, take other numbers. The list of known faults is the ratchet that the tests of ST-STD-CODE use: it can only shrink, so a new fault in a fill fails the test.

title: Each file of a Delivering fill meets each rule of the code standard for its kind
when: Runs each rule check of the code standard test (ST-STD-CODE-R01 to ST-STD-CODE-R06) over the files that the fills of ST-DLV name, at the commit under test.
then: Expects no fault of any rule in those files, and no entry for them in the committed list of known faults.
notes: Uses the rule checks of internal/assure that the standard rule tests ST-STD-CODE-R01-T01 to ST-STD-CODE-R06-T01 run, limited to the files of ST-DLV. The ID T05 is the position of Delivering among the domains, so that the test plans of other domains, written at the same time, take other IDs.

title: Each file of Extending meets every rule of the code standard that applies to its kind
when: Run the code standard check of internal/assure over the files that the technical records of ST-EXT name, at the commit under test.
then: Expects no fault of any rule of ST-STD-CODE for those files outside the committed list of known faults (ST-ASR-TOOL03) at the same commit, and no listed fault for those files that the tree no longer has.
notes: Not automated yet: the code standard tests (ST-STD-CODE-R01-T01 and the others) read the whole tree, not one domain. This test is the same check limited to the files of ST-EXT, so a fault shows by its domain.

title: Each fill of Supplying meets the rules of the code standard for its kind
when: Runs the code standard checks of internal/assure (the tests of ST-STD-CODE-R01 to R06) over the files that the fills of Supplying name.
then: Expects no fault in a file of Supplying outside the committed list of known faults.
notes: This reuses the checks of the standard rule tests, limited to the files of Supplying.

title: Assuring's tests give the same outcome on a workstation as in CI
when: Runs each suite command that holds tests of ST-ASR on a developer's workstation, as an unprivileged user, in a network namespace whose only routes are loopback and the network of the local services that the suite starts, with KUBECONFIG unset, no kube configuration file, and no CI provider token, registry credential or cloud credential in the environment, at the commit under test, and reads the outcome of each test ID of ST-ASR.
then: Expects each test ID that proves an obligation of ST-ASR to have an outcome, with the same result as the CI run of the same commit. Expects no test of ST-ASR to be skipped or to fail because a cluster, a hosted service, a credential or a route out is missing, and names each test that is.
notes: Not automated yet. The test number is the domain's position (ST-ASR 1 to ST-SUP 8), as for the tests of ST-PAT-GO-CODE. A missing outcome is a fault, not a pass. The tests of ST-ASR that need the hosted CI provider's API for the proof run and the release decision use a fake of the hosted CI provider's API that answers from fixed records, as the tests of qualify-compiler-release.py use a fake gh.

title: A run of Assuring's suites leaves no file, container or process outside its temporary folder
when: Runs each suite command that holds tests of ST-ASR with HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_STATE_HOME and TMPDIR each set to a new empty folder, and XDG_CACHE_HOME set to the cache of pinned downloads. then: Expects no file outside TMPDIR to be new or changed, apart from the outcomes file and new entries of the cache that are keyed by digest. Expects no container, volume, network or process that the run of ST-ASR started to be left. Names each one that is.
notes: Not automated yet. The test number is the domain's position (ST-ASR 1 to ST-SUP 8), as for the tests of ST-PAT-GO-CODE. A suite that stops its services only when its tests pass leaves them after a failure, so the test also runs with one test of ST-ASR made to fail.
